key_insight: Encoding a fixed, trained Binary Neural Network as a 1-safe Petri net makes inference steps explicit, yielding causal traces of how predictions arise.
engineering_relevance: This representation could help engineers inspect decision changes in resource-constrained, safety-relevant systems beyond checking input-output properties.
method: Compositionally translate BNN inference semantics into a 1-safe Petri net.
Represent computation steps as transitions and inference executions as firing sequences.
Contrast firing sequences to localise where a single-feature change alters the prediction.
evidence_signal: A worked example demonstrates exhaustive input-output equivalence with a reference implementation and trace-based localisation of a prediction change.
watch_item: Evidence is limited to a worked example; a general correctness-of-translation theorem and cross-model trace analysis remain future work.
paper_title: From Constraints to Causality: Petri net Encodings for Explaining Binary Neural Network Inference
